Proven ability to support over 30,000 employees internationally and deliver a 100% compliance rate across HR operations, in help and coordination with leaders and offshore teams globally. Expertise in bridging the gap between people strategy and technology implementation to enhance efficiency and organizational scaling.

Freelance & Consulting | Remote Globally | November 2021 - Present

Engineered secure, cross-client HTML email marketing landscapes and implemented responsive interactive UI features, including smart floating communication widgets, live chat trigger panels, and high-conversion navigation flows, while integrating IBM Full Stack Software Developer certifications to ensure technical excellence.

### Offshore, Shared Services HR Specialist

Managed the end-to-end employee lifecycle for a 30,000+ global workforce, executing high-volume onboarding of 70+ agents weekly and processing critical compliance documentation with a perfect 100% audit record. Administered cross-functional tickets for payroll, recruiting, and operations, while streamlining ticketing system workflows and onboarding protocols to substantially improve service quality.

### Customer Experience Agent

Resolved a wide range of customer issues, order placements, modifications, billing, and cancellations for Amazon US/UK campaigns under strict SLA limits. Handled complex disputes and tracked fulfillment delays across multiple live channels, consistently maintaining high satisfaction metrics.
